map_clouds.name: Cloud layer
map_clouds.description: Clouds drifting over the world from far away, parting as the camera comes down. Off leaves the borders clear at every distance. Also a button on the map bar and on the country-select screen.

map_mist.name: Fog-of-war mist
map_mist.description: Decorative mist over unseen ground. Turning it off does not reveal provinces or enemy forces; the intelligence mask stays unchanged.
